content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete stack of tools that let you sell digital products directly to buyers. No platforms. No subscriptions. No middlemen. You own the hosting, the backend logic, the payment processing, and the file delivery. Everything is deployed under your control. This matters because conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in regions like Kenya, Nigeria, and Zimbabwe. Even when they are available, they can freeze your account or block transactions without warning. Crypto payments solve this. They are borderless, permissionless, and irreversible. But accepting crypto is not enough. You need a system to verify payments, deliver files, and manage orders. That’s what this infrastructure provides. It’s not a workaround. It’s a permanent solution. Built to last. Built to scale. Built for creators who refuse to be locked out.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and decentralized. It uses free or low-cost tools that work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. Here’s how it works: A buyer sends crypto to your wallet. NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. The webhook triggers your backend logic. The backend checks the payment, logs the order, and sends the file download link. Everything happens automatically. No manual intervention. No buyer accounts required. No KYC. The buyer gets their product instantly. You get paid directly to your wallet. The system is transparent, secure, and efficient. It’s infrastructure, not an app. You own it. You control it.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who sell fonts, templates, presets, ebooks, courses, and software. It’s built for creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It’s built for creators who want full control over their commerce stack. It’s not built for people who want a quick fix. It’s built for people who want a permanent solution. It’s built for people who understand that infrastructure is the foundation of sovereignty. If you’re selling digital products and can’t use Stripe or PayPal, this is for you. If you’re tired of platforms locking you out, this is for you. If you want to own your commerce stack, this is for you. It’s not easy. But it’s worth it. Because once it’s deployed, it’s yours. Forever.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your sales stack.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is made of five core components. First, the storefront. Hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Free. Fast. Secure. Second, the backend logic. Built with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Handles payment verification, order logging, and file delivery. Third, the order storage. Supabase or Google Sheets. Lightweight. Scalable. Fourth, the file delivery. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Instant. Reliable. Fifth, the payment processor. NOWPayments. Supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. 0.5% fee. No KYC. These components work together seamlessly. They’re integrated via APIs and webhooks. The result is a fully automated commerce system. You don’t need to manage it. It manages itself. You focus on creating. It handles the selling. That’s the power of sovereign infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for beginners. It uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Deployed in 48 hours. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is for professionals. It uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. If you want to build it yourself, get the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all blueprints, templates, and guides. Instant download. No deployment required. Once you have the kit, follow the step-by-step instructions. Set up your storefront. Configure your backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments. Test the system end-to-end. When it’s ready, load your products. Start selling. The process is technical. But it’s not complicated. And the result is worth it. You’ll have a commerce stack that works anywhere, for anyone, forever.

If you’re ready to take control of your commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is your starting point. It includes all six blueprints, seven templates, and a NOWPayments integration guide. Everything you need to deploy sovereign infrastructure. No technical debt. No platform dependency. Just ownership. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 2. Set up your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Test the system end-to-end to ensure payments trigger file delivery. 6. Load your products into the system. 7. Deploy and start selling. 8. Monitor transactions and optimize as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. You don’t need to write code from scratch. Follow the instructions, and you’ll have a working stack.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. Transactions cost under $0.10.
Do I need to host my files?
Yes. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are free or low-cost. Your files are delivered instantly after payment verification.
What happens if a payment fails?
The system automatically retries verification. If the payment is invalid, the buyer is notified. No files are delivered until payment confirms.
Can I scale this for more products?
Yes. The infrastructure is designed to scale. Add more products to your storefront and backend logic. The system handles the rest.
